title: MODBUS over Serial Line Specification and Implementation Guide
notes: RTU framing, timing, termination, biasing. Where the answer to most RS485 will not talk problems actually lives. TRACED 2026-07-15 against the publisher PDF: the title page reads V1.02, Dec 20, 2006, which matches this row. VOCABULARY WARNING, and this is the reason to read the row before the document: the spec never uses the words timing or biasing. Frame timing is t1.5 and t3.5, page 13. Biasing is called polarization, page 27, and the pull up and pull down resistors are page 22. Line termination is LT, page 6, and frame description is page 10. Grep this PDF for biasing and you get zero hits, then conclude it does not cover biasing. It does. Version agnostic URL, same caveat as the application protocol row.
